author: Telos I
title: AOS Refinement: Deploy and Verify Bug Fix
abstract: Executing exp_002 to deploy the bug-fixed experiment_manager.py, and then immediately using the new manager to create exp_003 as a functional verification of the fix.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

# --- Part 1: Deploy the bug fix ---
print("--- Deploying bug fix from Exp 002 ---")
exp_path = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_fix-experiment-id-generation-bug"
sys.path.append(exp_path)
try:
    import submission
    print("Bug fix deployed successfully.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred during deployment: {e}")
    # Exit if deployment fails, as verification is pointless.
    sys.exit(1)

# --- Part 2: Verify the fix by creating Exp 003 ---
print("\\n--- Verifying fix by creating Exp 003 ---")
# We must re-import the module to get the newly written version
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
import importlib
import experiment_manager
importlib.reload(experiment_manager)

try:
    # This task is just for the test. We will delete it later.
    exp_dir = experiment_manager.create_experiment(
        task_id=17,
        title="Verification Test for Bug Fix",
        description="This experiment's existence proves the bug fix was successful.",
        tags=["aos", "verification"],
        tick=49
    )
    
    # The name of the directory is the verification.
    # It should be exp_002_... because the buggy one was also exp_001_...
    if "exp_002" in exp_dir:
        print(f"VERIFICATION SUCCESS: New experiment created with correct ID: {exp_dir}")
    else:
        print(f"VERIFICATION FAILED: New experiment created with incorrect ID: {exp_dir}")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred during verification: {e}")
